item.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Modify Cluster Db Revision

request.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Modify Cluster Db Revision

description.content: Modifies the database revision of a cluster. The database revision is a unique revision of the database running in a cluster.

query.description:
(Required)

The unique identifier of a cluster whose database revision you want to modify.

Example: examplecluster
(Required) The identifier of the database revision. You can retrieve this value from the response to the DescribeClusterDbRevisions request.
